title: Harden the bounded log subject: strip non-printing scalars and take the final path component on both separators (fix SEC-21.5-02, SEC-21.5-03)

conformance.reason: Task 21.11 corrects the plugin's own log-subject string handling so no non-printing Unicode scalar and no directory/drive/share component can reach the operator-facing log. It introduces no new Jellyfin 12 API, lifecycle, or platform assumption, changes no provider contract, and implements already-accepted ADR-026 clauses 1-2 and the ADR-020 clause 4 redaction contract (the decision gate DG-22 is resolved). No pre-dispatch specialist conformance check is required.

rework.reason: Implementation review attempt 1 (after an infrastructure-aborted review that produced no report) returned CHANGES_REQUIRED with finding 21.11-F1 (MEDIUM): docs/decisions/ADR-020.md's v1.2 amendment note still stated the pre-fix 'Path.GetFileName'/host-native-path and 'control scalars removed' readings as the shipped contract, so the supersession the new ADR-026 task 21.11 note performs was incomplete on the surface that owns the clause 4 redaction contract. The worker appended a purely additive note to ADR-020.md (24 insertions, 0 deletions; no decision text edited). Implementation review attempt 2 returned APPROVED with 21.11-F1 resolved.

notes: The first implementation-worker delegation aborted with an upstream 'Insufficient account funds' error before doing any work (recorded as attempt 0, outcome FAILED); the account was refreshed and the task was re-dispatched. The first implementation-reviewer invocation completed without a text response and produced no report (recorded as attempt 0, outcome FAILED); it was re-dispatched and produced the attempt-1 CHANGES_REQUIRED review. Two sessions in this task therefore carry attempt 0.

SEC-21.5-02 fixed: LogSubject.NormalizeFileName's removal predicate is now exactly the documented non-printing set Cc/Cf/Zl/Zp (superset of the pre-fix Cc-only Rune.IsControl), single scalar-wise pass, 128-scalar bound after removal, surrogate pairs never split, no whitespace collapse/trim. SEC-21.5-03 fixed: LogSubject.Create extracts the final component after the later of the last '/' and last '\' independently of host platform, so a Windows/UNC path cannot emit an account name or directory chain.

Discrimination independently reproduced three times: the pre-fix probe (HEAD LogSubject.cs + the committed tests) is Failed 25 / Passed 27 / Total 52; the post-fix focused run is 52/52. Default suite 0/1966/66/2032; host-guarded 0/1986/46/2032; LogRedactionTests 167/167; no golden or RenderVersion/schema change.

Carried non-blocking findings: test-quality TQ-21.11-01..04 (LOW test-strengthening: a Windows-host-only regression guard gap; whitespace-trim not directly probed; Co/Cn/Mc not exercised; an in-component backslash truncation case), TQ-21.11-05/06/07 (INFO: the stale docs/release/build-and-release.md matrix is task 21.12's to re-derive; the URL-shaped case; the backslash assertion helper). Implementation-reviewer 21.11-F3 (Cf removal drops U+200D/U+200C from emoji ZWJ sequences — mandated floor, adjudicated at 21.14) and 21.11-F4 (limitations SEC-5 wording). None block; the adjudication of the over-removal boundary belongs to task 21.14.
This task does not create, change, or remove any docs/limitations register entry; the disposition of SEC-21.5-02/03 belongs to the task 21.14 security review.
